description: Search the laws, regulations and standards this installation's agents have already read off the official sites (EUR-Lex, legislation.gov.uk, Fedlex, FATF and others) — by words and by meaning. Not a web search. Each hit: the act's url, title, the day its text is as of, an offset into the text and a snippet around the match. Open where the company lets an agent role read laws.

limit.description: How many passages, at most 20. Default 8.

query.description: What to look for, e.g. 'beneficial owner 25% threshold'.

name: search_legal_library
